blocks.text: Match preview: Sri Lanka face India in 2nd Test (TEST) on Sun, 23 Aug, 2026, 10:00 am at Sinhalese Sports Club Colombo. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Spin-friendly Sri Lankan tracks; deteriorate quickly on day 4–5 in Tests.
Rain showers · High 29°C / Low 24°C · Rain: 7.5 mm · Wind: up to 20 km/h. Rain likely — DLS may apply; favour bowlers who hit the deck and teams with depth.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
